notes.title: CODE: PANDORA 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Friends, fans — and yes, even haters.

While we're still preparing the remake of Witch 1, I’m excited to present the next chapter: CODE: Pandora.
Originally, the Absolute Weapon was supposed to be just a DLC for the first game — a small side adventure on a unique planet. But, as fate would have it, DLC development dragged on, and content kept piling up. So, with the iron will of the Dark Lord — and a random push of the launch button by our resident Goblin — it was decided: this story deserved a full sequel.

What’s different this time?
The biggest change: we’re no longer limited to a single planet. Now, your adventures will take you across nine worlds, with your headquarters stationed on the intergalactic base Ghost-5. From there, you’ll be contacting the lords of the Pandora galaxy, and your ultimate goal will be to piece together the full coordinates of the shadow planet where the Absolute Weapon is hidden.

There’s more — for the first time, Driply won’t be the only playable character. You’ll be joined by Lika, who, unlike diplomatic Driply, specializes in sabotage. But the choice is yours: plot daring sabotage missions, or befriend everyone in sight — it’s all up to you.

In the end, whether you get the coordinates by force, by cunning, or by friendship, the adventure will be yours to shape.

Thank you all for supporting the games and the Pandora universe — just as you did with Witch.

With love and respect,
Elbaf45

notes.title: Tales from the Darkside
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Happy summer everyone! Have a fun and eventful summer everyone!
[b]So first of all:[/b]
In honor of summer, the release of a port for steam deck, and in anticipation of the release of the game Witch 4.... and in honor of Tlazdine of course :)
Release of DLC The Mad World
A small adventure in the world of clowns, referencing the second part of the game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046730/_3/?curator_clanid=34719194
[spoiler]If you just want to free your sister, follow the clown (portals should be opened in the direction the clown is traveling)
If you want to see an orgy, go around all the clowns, take all the chalk, and go to your sister[/spoiler]
[b]Secondly:[/b]
Release version of the game Witch 3 for Linux
A build of the game for Linux has been uploaded to the server. (builds for ubuntu and manjaro)
You can set the compatibility in the steam deck settings to Steam Linux Runtime 1.0
The controller should also be set to Keyboard + mouse. If you click on the controller icon, go to Community Layouts and you can download the keyboard (WASD) layout (Steam deck compatible) by
Elbaf45 WASD 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42568944/ee0ef2ffec9408acbd6ac95476a9f2d80cec49e3.png[/img]
Go to special settings and set the checkbox to steam deck. [u]This way the control hints will be synchronized with your steam deck[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42568944/d301b7e9828a415766e70054687c7530f0a33248.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42568944/5e8d5703e59f28e39fe3cd54b4b65adcd99fb45f.jpg[/img]
Thirdly
A new menu for DLC has been added to the game. If you launch the DLC from the new menu, autosaving will work. Normal saving will not work. (If you need saves, you can use the book of fairy tales in the game)
Also, the gallery is duplicated in the new menu, and for the DLC "The Mad World" the gallery is only in the new menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42568944/833b41877985924adb59616b831338d0039a2f0c.jpg[/img]
P.S
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2731300/_4/
Thank you all! See you later!

notes.title: Ghost in the Fog
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Before the upcoming holiday, [strike]Christmas[/strike], oh no, Halloween, a small addition has been released - Ghost in the Fog.
You can find this addition in the book of fairy tales in your inventory (you can start a new game). The point is to get out of the ghostly forest, and for this you need to deal with 6 ghosts. Well, of course, you don’t have to get out, but “make friends with them.” As always, the choice is yours.
Don't get lost in the forest, this is a place that doesn't exist, and Laughing Man can make you wander there for a very long time.
Once again, happy Samhain to everyone!

notes.title: Puppeteer: Control game release
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
So the release of the game Puppeteer: Control
This is a small and very simple game about master of puppets.
I decided that before the Witch 4, I need to talk a little about the game characters from past games. So you can find out where master of puppets came from. The game time is about 30 minutes, but after you give 6 souls to the scarecrow, you will receive a Barbie doll))) And you don’t have to leave the sublunary world, the game doesn’t end. If there are votes for development, it will be possible to expand the doll collection, expand the house and add rooms.
Well, there will be a couple more games ahead of Witch 4, about the Demon of Candles and Melissa (yes again)
It was great to hear and see you all again!
